title: Phil Harris's compliment when Hirsch planned to leave
summary: Phil Harris told his band that Hirsch was like a fly in a zipper, meaning the band was no good without him.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: when I was going to leave Pete.

He found out about it, and he said, you know that every person here is an integral part of this band. He says, just like a man's got to have his pair of pants made. He's got two pockets in it in the front, two in the back, and belt straps to hold belt up. He says, but God for Harris to me is like a fly in a zipper. He says, well, if you leave him out, he says it's no good. I thought that was a great compliment. Yeah, it was.
